scenarios.description: Persistent memory leak in the checkout-service JVM heap causing OOM conditions. Memory utilization climbing from 75% to 94% over 45 minutes. GC pressure escalating, response times degrading.
Deployment of v2.8.0 to api-gateway introduced a regression causing 42% HTTP 5xx error rate. Errors began immediately post-deploy at 14:05 UTC. Previous stable revision is v2.7.9.
Traffic surge causing p99 latency on api-gateway to spike from 180ms to 4.8s. CPU utilization at 95%, request queue depth growing. More instances needed to absorb load.

Sudden burst of HTTP 500 errors from payment-service. Error rate jumped from 0.1% to 68% within 2 minutes. Stack traces show a corrupted in-memory session cache causing NullPointerException on every request.
Shared library upgrade (commons-http v4.5.14) deployed to order-service caused connection pool exhaustion, cascading into inventory-service and notification-service.
Slow, gradual CPU and memory creep on recommendation-service. ML model inference cache warming up without bound. SLO not yet breached but trending will cause breach in ~12 minutes.
Availability drop on sitemedic-demo-app to 72%. HTTP 4xx/5xx rate climbed steadily over 20 minutes, health check endpoint returning intermittent 503s.
CPU utilization on sitemedic-demo-app climbed from 45% to 98% due to a runaway background job processing a malformed message queue batch.
Sustained 55% error rate after a bad config push set DB_POOL_SIZE=0. All requests failing with connection acquisition timeout.
Memory utilization climbing steadily from 68% to 93% due to unbounded HTTP response cache growth with no eviction policy.

scenarios.display_name: Slow Response — sitemedic-demo-app DB query regression
scenarios.description: p99 response time spiked from 190ms to 8.2s after a missing database index was introduced by a schema migration. Full table scans on every /api/search request.
